[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.List

def implementation (numbers: List Int) : Bool :=
let n := numbers.length
let rec check_pairs (i: Nat) : Bool :=
  if i = n then false
  else
    let j := i + 1
    if j = n then check_pairs (i + 1)
    else
      if numbers[i]! + numbers[j]! = 0 then true
      else check_pairs (j + 1)
check_pairs 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma pair_sum_to_zero_exists
(numbers: List Int)
(i j: Nat)
(h_i_lt_len: i < numbers.length)
(h_j_lt_len: j < numbers.length)
(h_i_ne_j: i ≠ j)
(h_sum_zero: numbers[i]! + numbers[j]! = 0)
: 2 ≤ numbers.length ∧ (∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length ∧ numbers[i]! + numbers[j]! = 0)
:=
by
  simp [h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_i_ne_j, h_sum_zero]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation numbers
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  by_cases h_exists_zero: exists_zero
  -- case where exists_zero
  simp [h_exists_zero]
  apply And.intro
  have h_pair_sum_zero := h_exists_zero.prop
  simp [h_pair_sum_zero]
  have h_i := h_pair_sum_zero.2.1
  have h_j := h_pair_sum_zero.2.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_pair_sum_zero.2.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_pair_sum_zero.2.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_pair_sum_zero.2.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_pair_sum_zero.2.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  apply And.intro
  intros
  apply And.intro
  intro h_0_eq_numbers_len
  simp [h_0_eq_numbers_len]
  have h_i := h_exists_zero.2.1.1
  have h_j := h_exists_zero.2.1.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_exists_zero.2.1.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_exists_zero.2.1.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_exists_zero.2.1.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_exists_zero.2.1.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  have h_i := h_exists_zero.2.2.1
  have h_j := h_exists_zero.2.2.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_exists_zero.2.2.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_exists_zero.2.2.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_exists_zero.2.2.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_exists_zero.2.2.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  -- case where not exists_zero
  simp [h_exists_zero]
  apply And.intro
  have h_no_pair_sum_zero := h_exists_zero.1
  apply And.intro
  intros
  have h_i := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.1
  have h_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  have h_i := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.1
  have h_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  apply And.intro
  have h_0_eq_numbers_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.1
  simp [h_0_eq_numbers_len]
  apply And.intro
  intros
  have h_i := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.1
  have h_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.1.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
  have h_i := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.1
  have h_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.2
  have h_i_ne_j := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.3
  have h_i_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.4
  have h_j_lt_len := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.5
  have h_sum_zero := h_no_pair_sum_zero.2.2.6
  simp [h_i, h_j, h_i_ne_j, h_i_lt_len, h_j_lt_len, h_sum_zero]
[END]
